Popover Component
Shows popover content on click using custom popover system.
Similar to dropdown but can contain any content (not just menu items).
`withPopover()` gives it positioning and state management.

Prose Component
Reading container: caps the line measure, centers it, and sets the
long-form typography scale (defaults to the lg reading size) that
cascades into any contained lc-markdown.

The hint a pull to refresh draws above the list: a band as tall as the pull
so far, with an arrow that turns once a release would refresh, and a
spinner while the refresh runs. It holds no gesture; a host with
`withPullToRefresh` hands it `pullY` and `refreshing`.

<lc-pull-indicator .pull=${this.pullY} ?refreshing=${this.refreshing}></lc-pull-indicator>

doc.description:
Text Component

The one text primitive: inline text, headings (`level`) and section labels
(`eyebrow`). Light DOM with no render: the children are already the content,
so there is nothing to wrap. Styling lands on the host, the way `lc-badge`
does it, which also means a class on the call site still wins.
